answers.question: Should the bank details be changed?
answers.answer: No. Sender domain ellisonletings.co.uk differs from the genuine ellisonlettings.co.uk; Reply-To is protonmail; urgency and no-call request; policy needs call-back to number on file plus dual approval, neither done.

answers.question: What happens to the payout scheduled for Monday?
answers.answer: Held (HOLD-101) pending verification; it must not go to the new account. Fraud team to decide release to the existing account after call-back.

answers.question: Who do you contact and through which channel?
answers.answer: Margaret by email at the address on file (MSG-102), not the Reply-To; fraud team via escalation ESC-103, who should phone her on the number on file.

If the request was genuinely from you, please let us know and we will arrange a security call-back to the phone number we already hold, which we are required to do before any change. If it was not you, please let us know so we can take extra steps to protect your account. Your Monday payment is on hold until this is checked, so it may be delayed. Kind regards, Mare & Co
